The '''Klaatu system''' was a [[Binary star system/Legends|binary star]] [[Star system/Legends|system]] located in the [[Airam sector/Legends|Airam sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] that contained [[Klaatu (astronomical object)|Klaatu]]. A [[Skirmish at Klaatu|space battle]] between the [[Airam (group)|Airam]] and the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] took place near Klaatu during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="XWvTF:BoP" />
